name: 9X9
author: sd88me
summary: A circuit-solved TR-909 for Gen2 MPC devices: kick, snare, toms, rim and clap are the 909's own circuits, solved with Lemus. Hats, ride and crash play the 909's ROMs, which you supply; without them 9W9's samples play. Drive, sends, master bus, extra controls, Latency. CPU heavy, Gen2 only.
